content.short: NFT Public Library mints public-domain artwork and literature as royalty-free Cardano NFT collectibles.
content.description: NFT Public Library is a Cardano NFT project focused on public-domain artwork, literature, and cultural material. The project mints collectibles without royalties and aims to preserve accessible creative works in a metaverse-style library format. Its catalog is organized around transparency for collectors, consistent minting guidelines, and support for public-good initiatives. Rather than acting as a general marketplace, NFT Public Library uses NFTs to curate and distribute works believed to be in the public domain.
